messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Problem 8 Project
parts:
Thanks for the notice. Wallace shouldn’t crash — it should tell you what the problem is instead, and we’ll look into that.

Are you using the Worldclim data downloaded through Wallace, or your own environmental data? If you use your own, you need to make sure that the rasters have an extent large enough for the projections you want to make. If you download through Wallace, you are getting the global dataset unless it is 30 arcsec (1 km) — in this case a single tile is downloaded (because of download limitations using the raster package) and you can only project to areas within that tile. If you are trying to project to other times, as we use the Worldclim database currently for all future climate scenarios, unfortunately it will only work with the bioclim layers. 

Jamie Kass
PhD Candidate
City College of NY
